name: Pagination
title: Pagination
summary: Moves through a long list split into pages (news, resources, partner lists): numbered pages with Previous / Next, a compact "Page 3 of 12" form, or a Load more button.
whenToUse: Use numbered pagination for lists people browse and return to, where the URL should hold the page: news, stories, the resource library.
Use compact pagination on phones and in tight spaces such as cards and side panels.
Use Load more for feeds people scan once, such as partner stories or radio episodes.
whenNotToUse: Do not paginate lists under about 12 items; show them all.

props.name: variant
props.description: `numbered` shows page buttons with Previous / Next; `compact` shows round arrows around "Page 3 of 12".

props.name: hrefFor
props.description: Builds the URL of a page. Use real `?page=` URLs so pages can be shared.

props.name: onPageChange
props.description:
Called when a page link is clicked, with the target page and the click event.
Call `event.preventDefault()` for client-side paging without a navigation.

props.name: linkComponent
props.description:
Component used to render page links. Defaults to `'a'`.
Pass `next/link` (or any component accepting `href`, `className`, `onClick`, `aria-*` and `children`).

props.name: previousLabel
props.description: Visible text of the Previous link (numbered). Leave empty for an arrow-only look.

props.name: nextLabel
props.description: Visible text of the Next link (numbered).

props.name: previousAriaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the round Previous arrow (compact).

props.name: nextAriaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the round Next arrow (compact).

props.name: renderStatus
props.description:
Renders the compact status ("Page 3 of 12", current number bold). Receives the page and the count.
Without it only the bold current number and the total are shown, separated by a slash.

variantNotes: **Page button (`.nv-pg-btn`):** 44px round, 15px/500 `var(--charcoal-900)`. Hover `var(--gray-100)`. Focus: blue outline + `var(--shadow-focus)`. Current: filled `var(--charcoal-900)`, white 600, `aria-current="page"`.
**Previous / Next (`.nv-pg-nav`):** outlined 44px pills with arrows. At the ends: `aria-disabled="true"` (opacity .45, not clickable).
**Compact (`.nv-pg-compact`):** 44px round arrow buttons (`.nv-pg-round`) either side of "Page 3 of 12".

**Load more:** default `.btn-secondary`; loading adds `aria-busy="true"` and a `.nv-spin-dark` spinner with "Loading"; all loaded swaps the button for `.nv-done` "You've seen them all". The `.nv-bar` uses `var(--gradient-line)` to show progress.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Show first, last, current ±1, and `…` for gaps. Never show more than 7 page numbers.
The current page is filled charcoal, not Horizon Blue. Pagination never takes the group's blue primary.
Keep Previous and Next in place at the ends; disable them, never hide them, so the row does not jump.
Use real links with `?page=` URLs for numbered pagination so pages can be shared.
Use `→`-style arrows only (inline SVG). Never use ↗ or › here.
Load more: always say how many are shown ("Showing 12 of 48"), and append in place without moving scroll.
Centre numbered pagination under the list, 40–48px below the last item.

accessibility: Mark the current page with `aria-current="page"`; give arrow-only buttons `aria-label="Previous page"` / `"Next page"`.
Compact status uses `aria-live="polite"` so the new page is announced.
After Load more, move focus to the first new item and announce "12 more stories loaded".
content: Counts are real ("Showing 12 of 48" in the preview is a sample).
Status: "Page 3 of 12", with the current number in bold.

Previous 1 … 4 5 6 … 12 Next
… Page 3 of 12 …
Showing 12 of 48
